notes.title: As it turns out, making games is HARD!
notes.content:
TL; DR: Here’s an updated page for my next game. Here’s my discord. Come to hang out and see the process of making this game. There might be a public beta test soon.

[h1]Hello everybody! [/h1]It’s been a while! Hope you still remember me. I am that guy who made the Loading Screen thingy.

A couple of years ago I announced Seven: Reboot and was expecting to finish it in under a year. But as it turns out making games is hard! I’ve spent the past 2 years making this game and adding something new almost every day. What was expected to be a quick and easy game turned into the most interesting project I’ve ever worked on.

And it is not done. Not even close!

[h1]But now I can show you this! [/h1]It is the first public gameplay for the game. It is not a final trailer, just a little teaser for you. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/654200/Seven_Reboot/]Here's an updated game page[/url]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/654200/Seven_Reboot/

That is all I can show for now but if you want more, you can join the Seven: Reboot [url=https://discord.gg/E6wWz8X]discord server[/url] and follow the development of the game. There I post weekly free form game-dev logs. We often discuss the changes and design choices. We are a small community but everybody is welcome to [url=https://discord.gg/E6wWz8X]join[/url]! 

[h1]Soon (or not) there will be a short public beta test of the game.[/h1] It will be announced in this discord server. If you want to try the game at its current state then join to be informed. No need to solve ARG puzzles anymore, Hehe! Everybody can play!

[h1]The previous private test went fine.[/h1] People who have managed to solve the puzzles joined the server and played through the game together. Most of them said that the game is good and gave a lot of useful feedback.

[h1]Here are some quotes from the testers:[/h1]

[quote]LongingRhombus9: "It is a puzzle game that requires quite the bit of thinking in which almost everything there is, is relevant to the solutions in one way or another, and the satisfaction of completing is so good. Hehe."[/quote]

[quote]SidSef: “It's a puzzle game where you don't require any cryptography skills to play or enjoy. I like that it contains a vast amount of secrets and always feels like there is more to be unlocked as even after the credits of the game I was still hooked and interested wanting to go back and play more. I'm sure there is stuff I haven't even found yet!”[/quote]

[quote]Rito141: “I would describe it as a simple, yet complicated at the same time, really enjoyable puzzle game, which has a nice atmosphere. And I’d suggest it to pretty much anyone who likes a good challenge”[/quote]

[h1]The game is slowly taking shape[/h1] and it was such an adventure making it. I am learning skills I didn’t ever know existed! When it will be done, it is going to be something nobody has ever played before.

[h1]I can’t give an estimated release date. [/h1]"I don't want to rush this, I want to make it the best it can be. It may take 1 or 2 or 3 or god knows how many years until I am satisfied with what I’ve made. So, don’t expect it to be out soon. [url=https://discord.gg/E6wWz8X]join the discord[/url], and let’s make this game together!

[h1]AND ADD [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/654200/Seven_Reboot/]THE GAME[/url] TO YOUR WISHLIST RIGHT NOW![/h1] Let it sit there for a couple of years :) 

[h1]Cake Eater Games
Cake is not a lie[/h1]

[url=https://discord.gg/E6wWz8X]Discord server[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/654200/Seven_Reboot/]Updated game page[/url]

notes.title: New game in development!
notes.content:
Hello everybody! It is me, Cake Eater or Ruslan. I’d like to make a short announcement. 

First of all thanks everyone for positive feedback on LSS. I was not expecting that much of attention to such a silly stupid awful game. Some of your comments and reviews are just amazing! It was very fun to read them. I got a chance to talk to a lot of players and made some new friends. And that’s very nice.

I’ll talk more about LSS later but for now I Just want to say thank you.

[h1]Now Let's get to the point.[/h1]

I have been working on another game for a while now. It is called “Seven: Reboot”. Some of you have already heard of it. It is a remake of one of my old games. And it finally got a [url=store.steampowered.com/app/654200/Seven_Reboot/]page[/url] on Steam! I would like you to go to the [url=store.steampowered.com/app/654200/Seven_Reboot/]page[/url] and check it out. And if you will get interested in Seven make sure to add it to your wishlist, so that you will know when it comes out.

Seven is a very unusual game. I don’t think I have ever seen anything like it. “Seven: Reboot” is a cryptic experimental puzzle game. It’s about numbers and their meaning. It is about information and ways to hide it in everything! I really like how it’s turning out so far and hope that when it comes out you will like it too.

If you are interested check out the [url=store.steampowered.com/app/654200/Seven_Reboot/]page[/url] and also… I have left you something interesting ;)

There is a [url=cakeeatergames.ru/Seven/]website[/url] and there is “something” there. if you will find that “something” and send me some screenshots you will get a chance to participate in a beta test of the game and of course get a game itself. (Limited Offer, only 10 people)

That’s it for now. Thanks for your time. Good luck
